title: Gate B: the inference gateway, its budget, its context binding and its second reading
note: Every mutation here would let a model call do something the gateway exists to stop: spend without authority, spend past a budget, answer under stale rules, leak a credential, or turn into a proposal that is not what the model said. The second reader's mutations check that it would notice each of those independently. MR1-MR7: the fold refuses a malformed record in its own words, infer() raises only what it documents, and the worker boundary refuses a reply that is not one (AUD-080 to AUD-082).

mutations.name: IG1_anyone_may_grant_spending_on_replay
mutations.rationale: a budget appended by any actor would be spending authority on every load. IG2 (IG2_anyone_may_publish_a_budget), anchored on the one rule left when the writer's and the replay's were merged, made this same mutant and is folded into it (AUD-087). Its rationale: an agent could grant itself money to spend; the writer runs this rule too, so the record would be written as well as replayed
